name: Apex Solventless Live Rosin O2 Disposable | Wilson! Zero #3
description:
Wilson! Zero #3 Tier 1 Live Rosin *Exclusive Apex Solventless Phenotype*

Wilson! Zero #3 is one of the very first plants we hunted from seed back in 2017! Comprised of Banana OG, Trop Cookies, and Papaya, she truly expresses the essence of many different tropical fruits. She is reminiscent of a sour Hawaiian island beverage, and is sure to make you feel like you're at the beach!

Cross: (Papaya x Banana OG) x Trop Cookies

Terp Profile: Tropical, Mango, Gas
